identity.industry: Branded fresh protein / organized meat & seafood — omnichannel food platform (consumer staples · fresh foods)

summary.oneLiner: Zappfresh (listed entity DSM Fresh Foods) is an 11-year-old, IPO-listed (BSE SME-type) branded fresh-protein platform aiming to consolidate the largely unorganized Indian meat/seafood market via an omnichannel model (online D2C + B2B HoReCa + emerging partner meat-shops). Differentiated by **backward integration** — direct farmer/FPO partnerships in poultry (live-bird, whole-carcass monetization incl. feet/feathers) and a new ~270-acre aquaculture build (Marina Aqua) — which the company credits for being the *only profitable* player in a peer set it describes as loss-making (peers rely on quick-commerce third-party channels that carry commission/marketing burn). FY26 was a "transformational" year: revenue +69% to ~INR 221 cr, EBITDA nearly doubled to INR 31 cr, reported PAT INR 14.4 cr (normalized INR 18.4 cr ex-deferred-tax). Next leg of growth is value-added frozen RTE (Meevaa, acquired export business) and physical partner-store rollout. Key tension: aggressive B2B/aquaculture scale-up has temporarily diluted gross margin and B2C, and operating cash flow is negative due to working-capital intensity.

scorecard:
| Metric | FY26 | FY25 | YoY | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue (full-year) | ~INR 221 cr | INR 131 cr | **+69%** | (transcript OCR shows "INR 2.21 crores" — clearly INR 221 cr) |
| Revenue (H2) | INR 125 cr | INR 65 cr | **~+100%** | driven by B2B HoReCa + rising fish/seafood |
| EBITDA (full-year) | INR 31 cr | INR 16 cr | **~+94%** | margin ~13.5% (FY25 ~12.5%) |
| EBITDA (H2) | INR 15.9 cr | INR 11.1 cr | **+42%** | H2 margin ~13% (vs ~17% H2FY25) |
| PBT (full-year) | INR 43.2 cr | INR 11.7 cr | **+269%** | margin ~10.4% (FY25 8.9%) — *note: PBT > EBITDA is internally inconsistent in transcript; likely OCR/figure error, flag* |
| PBT (H2) | INR 11.5 cr | INR 8 cr | +43% | |
| PAT reported (FY26) | INR 14.4 cr | INR 9 cr | **+59%** | includes deferred-tax adjustment drag |
| PAT normalized (FY26) | **INR 18.4 cr** | — | — | mgmt "true" PAT ex-deferred-tax; stated as the go-forward earnings power |
| Gross margin (by channel) | B2C ~45–50%; B2B ~20–25% | — | — | mix shift to B2B compressed blended GM |
| Net debt / equity | < 0.5x | higher | reduced | cash ~INR 20–25 cr; deleveraged in FY26 |

**One-offs / adjustments:** (1) Deferred-tax adjustment reduced reported PAT by ~INR 4 cr (14.4 reported vs 18.4 normalized); mgmt says this deferred-tax drag (carried H1+H2 from prior years) **will not recur from H1FY27**. (2) Margin optics distorted by deliberate B2B mix surge (one-time absorption of aquaculture/farmer volumes).
guidance (critical):
- **FY27 revenue growth: 70–80%** (explicit), with continued profitability/operating-leverage improvement.
- **2-year revenue CAGR ~70%** (per investor PPT); base CAGR historically 50–60%.
- **EBITDA margin: +3–4% improvement over next two years** — drivers: aquaculture (+200–300 bps on fish contribution), higher RTE share (RTE gross margin ~50%), and B2C share recovery toward 50:50.
- **Bottom-line: ~25% improvement** on PAT margin profile (combination of mix + removal of deferred-tax drag of ~10–20%).
- **Meevaa (RTE):** to contribute **15–20% of FY27 revenue** (~INR 70 cr+); currently INR 30–40 cr annualized run-rate (~INR 40 cr); peaked at INR 16 cr pre-acquisition, doubled within ~3 months; Meevaa EBITDA margin ~20% or "slightly more"; ~90% of that business is export (US/Canada/Europe), with FX tailwind. Long-run VA/frozen ambition: **20–25%+ of total revenue**.
- **Partner meat-shops:** 100 onboarded now → **300–400 by year-end** (longer-term "1000s"). Per-store ~INR 5 lakh/month revenue, net ~8–10% (~INR 50k profit/store/month).
- **Category mix FY27 target:** chicken ~40–45%; fish/seafood 30–35% (up from 27% in H2FY26); mutton reduced further; Meevaa 15–20%.
- **Channel mix:** B2B:B2C to normalize to ~50:50 at steady state (currently 68:32).
- **Cash flow:** operating cash flow positive expected in **2–3 years** (negative now by choice, growth/WC-driven).
order book / pipeline:
- No formal order book (B2C/B2B distribution model). Pipeline proxies: 300+ restaurants/institutional HoReCa customers serviced; ~300 seafood farmers + ~300 poultry/contract farmers integrated; ~100 partner stores onboarded (→300–400 target); Meevaa export run-rate INR 40 cr with retained anchor customers (e.g., Jubilant cited as a customer; Punjabi-Canadian community buyers; US "Baigan ka Bharta" SKU).
- M&A pipeline: **nothing immediate** — focus on consolidating Meevaa + aquaculture; opportunistic only.
segment:
- **Channel:** B2B HoReCa ~68% / B2C ~32% (vs ~48:52 in H1FY26 — B2C deliberately throttled to absorb aquaculture/farmer volume; net users ~80k–90k/month, down ~15% H/H from ~1 lakh; retention ~85%). B2C is currently **website-only** (no retail yet).
- **Category:** chicken ~50%; mutton ~25%; fish/seafood ~25% (fish rose 21% H1 → 27% H2 of FY26).
- **Geography:** NCR, Bangalore, Mumbai; expansion planned to Pune, Nashik, near-Bangalore markets; aquaculture/processing footprint in Kanpur, Ghaziabad, Nagpur, Assam; Meevaa plant in Chandigarh.
growth / optionality:
- **Meevaa Foods (frozen RTE):** acquired export-RTE business; 5,000+ orders in 48h of NCR launch; Chandigarh plant capacity ~INR 500 cr revenue; "Me First" campaign; gourmet North-Indian/NRI taste profile (avoids commoditized fries/nuggets); quick-commerce tie-ups (Amazon, BigBasket).
- **Aquaculture (Marina Aqua):** ~270 acres for fish farming/seedings; ~300 seafood-farmer FPO; expected to lift seafood margins over coming years.
- **Partner meat-shop network:** asset-light "sourcing+supply-chain+tech partner" model; analogy to OYO/1mg/PharmEasy local-cluster penetration; "inexpensive way to build brand."
- **Adjacent categories:** evaluating cross-sell adjacencies (more clarity in coming quarters).
- **Promoter warrants:** MD to exercise warrants post lock-in → adds promoter equity (currently ~28% promoter holding).
margins & cost:
- Blended EBITDA margin dipped (H2 ~13% vs ~17% H2FY25; ~400–500 bps) almost entirely due to **B2B mix surge** (B2B GM ~20–25% vs B2C ~45–50%; B2B share rose from ~20–25% in FY25 to ~70%).
- Margin recovery levers: aquaculture integration (+200–300 bps), RTE scale-up (GM ~50%), B2C mix normalization. RTE absorbs quick-commerce commissions (~25–30%) because of its high GM, unlike core fresh products which mgmt keeps on own channels to protect margin.
- Poultry input volatility hedged via contract farming/advances to farmers → price stability; whole-live-bird monetization (feet/feathers/ancillaries) is a structural cost advantage vs peers buying clean-slaughtered birds.
capex:
- Major investments: aquaculture build (~270 acres land — Kanpur, Ghaziabad, Nagpur, Assam); Meevaa Chandigarh state-of-the-art plant (INR 500 cr revenue capacity); farmer advances/working-capital for contract farming.
- No specific per-city capex figure given (asked but not quantified); partner-store model is asset-light (no heavy store capex).
capital allocation:
- Net debt/equity < 0.5x (deleveraged YoY); cash ~INR 20–25 cr; "good headroom" to raise additional debt.
- Operating cash flow negative — reinvested into working capital for scale; positive OCF targeted in 2–3 years; growth prioritized over near-term cash generation.
- Promoter to exercise warrants (add equity). No dividend discussion.
risks:
- **Negative operating cash flow** / high working-capital intensity in a perishables business (wastage/leakage risk explicitly flagged).
- **Margin dilution** from B2B-heavy mix; execution risk across multiple simultaneous initiatives (aquaculture, Meevaa, retail rollout).
- **Macro/geopolitical:** war/shipping disruption and raw-material pressure cited as biggest macro risk (Meevaa is export-heavy).
- **Competition:** frozen RTE is highly competitive vs large FMCG; domestic VA strategy admittedly faces "high competition."
- **Governance/float:** low promoter holding (~28%); reliance on warrant exercise; transcript figures show internal inconsistency (PBT > EBITDA) — data-quality/disclosure risk. Small-cap/SME liquidity.
mgmt tone: Confident, vision-led, narrative-heavy ("iconic organization," "large conglomerate"). Emphasizes profitability-with-growth and structural formalization opportunity. Slightly promotional (awards, UN Goodwill Ambassador, CII recognition). Investors pushed back on margin dip, B2C degrowth, and cash flow — management acknowledged the B2B mix trade-off candidly but deflected on precise forward numbers ("hesitating to give a specific number"). Investors requested quarterly updates and more IR cadence.
non-obvious:
- B2C **users actually declined ~15% H/H** (to ~80–90k/month) — a deliberate de-prioritization to feed B2B aquaculture volume, not demand weakness (per mgmt).
- Meevaa is fundamentally an **export/NRI play** (~90% export), so it's an FX-levered, taste-niche bet rather than a domestic frozen-FMCG fight — a different risk profile than headline "frozen RTE" suggests.
- Profitability edge is partly **byproduct monetization** (feet/feathers from live birds) — a procurement structural moat peers lack.
- Reported vs normalized PAT gap (14.4 vs 18.4) is purely deferred-tax timing; mgmt insists it vanishes from H1FY27.
- **Data caution:** OCR/figure inconsistencies — full-year revenue printed as "INR 2.21 crores" (read as INR 221 cr); FY26 PBT INR 43.2 cr exceeds EBITDA INR 31 cr, which is not arithmetically possible and should be treated as a transcript error pending the actual results/PPT.
challenges → beneficiaries:
- (No clear external beneficiary call-outs.) Structural beneficiary of unorganized→organized fresh-protein shift; backward-integrated FPO farmers benefit from advances/offtake. ✅/⭐ — none flagged.

qoq log: - **H2/FY26 (this call):** First detailed post-IPO full-year call. Rev FY26 ~INR 221 cr (+69%), EBITDA INR 31 cr (~doubled), PAT 14.4 cr reported / 18.4 cr normalized. Mix swung hard to B2B (68%) and fish rose to 27%. Launched Meevaa (frozen RTE, export-led) and Marina Aqua (aquaculture, 270 acres). Guided FY27 revenue +70–80%, EBITDA +3–4% over 2yr, Meevaa 15–20% of FY27 rev. Margin dip (17%→13% H2) attributed to B2B mix. Negative OCF; OCF-positive in 2–3 yrs. Promoter warrants to be exercised. (No prior-quarter concall note on file for comparison.)
